chat.emptyBody: Your desktop assistant for chat, coding, sandboxed commands and project files.
chat.planModeHint: Plan Mode: the agent describes the steps but does not run any tools.
chat.terminalPlaceholder: Type a command and press Enter
chat.loopStopTitle: The agent paused to avoid a loop
chat.loopStopContinuePrompt: Continue from where you left off, but do NOT repeat the previous action. Try a different approach.
chat.loopStopHintRepeated: It kept running the same action — it likely needs a different approach.
chat.loopStopHintNoProgress: Recent steps did not change anything. Give more specific guidance.
chat.loopStopHintFailure: Several steps failed in a row. Review the errors before continuing.
chat.loopStopHintReasoning: It repeated its reasoning without acting. Add a constraint or a concrete next step.
chat.loopStopHintTimeout: A step was taking too long. Continuing gives it more time.
chat.fullAccessWarning: Full access: the agent can run any tool without asking. This turns off automatically after 30 minutes.
chat.emptyTagline: Ask me to write code, run commands, or explore your project.
chat.noWorkspaceWarning: No workspace folder is open. Open a project before running tools so the agent has a safe place to work.
chat.approvalDangerous: This command matches the deny list and will always require approval.
chat.approvalReasonOutsidePlan: Not part of the approved plan
chat.approvalWriteWarning: This is a write operation. It requires explicit approval.
chat.approvalNoUndo: Changes will be applied directly to the server. No undo available.
chat.approvalRememberTool: Remember all commands from this tool
chat.approvalRememberScope: Remembered approvals apply only to this VPS + project and expire after 30 minutes.
chat.approvalCannotRemember: For safety, this operation requires explicit approval each time. It cannot be remembered because it can modify the system.
chat.applyChangesConfirm: Apply {{count}} file change(s) to your project?
chat.emptyTitleProject: What should we work on in {{project}}?
chat.templatePlaceholder: Describe what to do with this file...
chat.runCodeConfirm: Run this code on your machine?
chat.remoteNoVps: Select a VPS for this project
chat.remoteNoPath: Set the remote path for this project
chat.policyWarningTitle: This command is outside the project policy
chat.activitySummary: Ran {{commands}} commands, read {{files}} files, edited {{edits}} files
chat.questionSkipHint: Continue without an answer — the agent will use its own judgement
chat.attachFailed: That file could not be attached. It may be a credential file (never attached), unreadable, or larger than 8 MB.
chat.attachSkipped: Some files were skipped — a credential file, an unreadable file, or one over 8 MB.
chat.attachNoVisionHint: This model cannot see images. The file is still copied into the workspace, but switch to a vision-capable model (e.g. Gemini or GPT-4o) to have it read.
chat.attachmentSent: 📎 {{count}} attached file(s), copied into the workspace for the agent
chat.approvalGrantServer: Approve every command on {{server}} for 30 minutes
chat.approvalGrantScope: Scoped to this server and this project, expires automatically, revocable from the composer. The deny list still blocks dangerous commands, and nothing is remembered permanently.

settings.title: Settings
settings.showContextBeforeSend: Show a token & cost preview before every send (off by default)
settings.showJobsPanelAlways: Always show the background jobs panel
settings.showRawToolRowsHint: Tool calls already shown inside the execution trace are hidden by default.
settings.chatOnProjectSwitchHint: What to do with the current conversation when you open another project.
settings.showContextWarningHint: Only needed for older models with a small context window. Off by default.
settings.missingPath: Path not found on this system
settings.remoteHint: Add a folder that lives on a VPS. Remote projects open over SSH and are read/written through the remote shell.
settings.remoteNotFound: No matching folder found on the server
settings.approvalHint: Controls when the agent pauses for your approval before running a tool.
settings.planModeDefault: Start new chats in Plan Mode
settings.rememberApprovalMode: Remember my approval mode across restarts
settings.approvedCommandsHint: Actions you chose to always allow. Revoke one to be asked again.
settings.browseDirectoryHint: The directory is bundled with AI Desktop. Enable the ones you use.
settings.browserHint: Control which websites the agent may open. New sites always ask first.
settings.noPermissions: No websites configured yet — everything defaults to “Always ask”.
settings.codeReviewHint: Choose which repositories get an automatic review for every pull request.
settings.codeReviewNoAuth: Connect GitHub to list your repositories.
settings.thisPcOn: Local tools can read, write and run commands in your projects.
settings.thisPcOff: Local tools are disabled for this machine.
settings.noDevicesHint: Pairing other devices is coming soon.
settings.memoryHint: How much of the model context window the current chat uses.
settings.contextOverBudget: This chat is over the context budget. Consider starting a new chat.
settings.usageHint: Token usage for this session and all time.
settings.diagnosticDesc: Temporarily allow read-only access to system paths (/var/log, /proc, /etc/os-release) so the agent can diagnose a crash. Write access stays blocked. Expires automatically after 30 minutes.
settings.projectErrorInvalidPorts: Ports must be numbers between 1 and 65535
settings.projectErrorInvalidDomains: One or more domains are invalid
settings.projectErrorNotKeyMaterial: Reference only — do not paste the key itself
settings.toolsHint: Enable or disable the agent tool groups below.
settings.auditHint: Every agent decision is appended to a tamper-evident log. Verify recomputes the hash chain and reports the first broken line.
settings.auditNoProject: Select a project to see its audit file.
settings.auditError: Could not verify the audit file.
settings.themeHint: Day theme, dark theme, or follow the system setting.
settings.remoteWhat: A small JSON API on this machine only (127.0.0.1), so another program — a script, an editor plugin, a future mobile client over an SSH tunnel — can drive the app and read its status.
settings.remoteWhy: Off by default. No client ships with AI Desktop, which is why this looked mysterious in the status bar; it is a developer feature, so it lives here instead.
settings.remoteSecurity: Security: reachable only from this machine, every request needs the bearer token above, and the token is regenerated each time you start it. Keep it on only while you are using it.
settings.remoteCopyFailed: Could not copy to the clipboard.
settings.updatesHint: Checking and downloading is manual by design: nothing is fetched or installed without your click.
settings.updateUnverified: This release publishes no checksum, so the download could not be verified.
settings.updateFailed: The update could not be completed.

github.title: GitHub
github.cliDetecting: Looking for a GitHub CLI login…
github.cliFoundBody: The gh command is installed and signed in on this machine, so there is nothing to register and nothing to paste.
github.cliInstallHint: Install the GitHub CLI from cli.github.com and run "gh auth login", or connect the other way below.
github.cliLoginHint: Run "gh auth login" in a terminal, or connect the other way below.
github.whichCli: GitHub CLI — recommended: one click, because you are already logged in.
github.whichToken: Access token — no setup beyond creating the token once.
github.whichDevice: Device flow — needs you to register an OAuth App and paste its Client ID: the most steps.
github.deviceHint: Create a GitHub OAuth App with Device Flow enabled, paste its Client ID, then approve the code on github.com.
github.tokenHint: Create a Personal Access Token with the repo and read:user scopes and paste it here. Stored encrypted on this machine.
github.tokenNotReported: Token expiry: not reported by GitHub.
github.errorTitle: GitHub is not usable right now
github.disconnectTitle: Disconnect GitHub in AI Desktop only. Your gh CLI login is left untouched.

toast.actionFailed: The agent did not receive your answer:
toast.copyFailed: Could not copy to the clipboard.

onboarding.vpsBody: Connect a server over SSH to run remote commands. Pick a connected VPS in the chat header and the assistant can use the remote_shell tool.
onboarding.welcomeBody: AI Desktop connects an AI assistant to your local files, GitHub and VPS. Pick what you will mostly use it for — we will pre-select a model for you.
onboarding.connectBody: Add a DeepSeek, OpenAI, Anthropic or Gemini key in Settings. You can also add any OpenAI-compatible endpoint under “Custom providers”.
onboarding.projectBody: Projects point the assistant at a folder on your machine. Add one in Settings, or drag a folder onto the window later.
onboarding.doneBody: Use the model picker in the chat header to switch models any time. Press Ctrl+, to reopen Settings.

vps.noMatches: No matching folder found on the VPS.

search.hint: Type to search across the active project.
